experience.summary: AfterShoot is photo editing software with features such as culling, advanced editing, presets, and an AI coach for assisted editing.
points: Played a key role in developing the new product “Photon” from scratch through its first release.
Worked extensively on core functionality, including the import/export pipeline, image processing, rendering, filtering, metadata, and all database handling.
Optimized grid rendering on slow I/O devices, making it 7× faster.
Wrote an internal tool for parsing and writing XMP metadata, both in sidecar files and embedded within image files such as JPEG.

experience.summary: Helmer is a video, audio, and screen capture application with built-in video editing and project management.
points: Engineered a reliable backend encoder and decoder system in Rust using OS APIs, powering video and audio capturing and recording.
Delivered over 30 features and fixes, enhancing multi-platform support and overall application reliability.
Built an audio enhancement pipeline using an AI service.

experience.summary: Tailcall is an open-source Rust project that provides easy orchestration to build high-performance GraphQL backends.
points: Enhanced the implementation of GraphQL benchmarks for comparing the performance of various GraphQL frameworks, resulting in more accurate and diverse benchmark cases.
Developed and integrated Grafana K6 testing with InfluxDB for storage, utilizing Grafana visualizations to generate automated performance graphs.
Implemented a feature to support custom headers for gRPC reflection server requests.

experience.summary: RustDesk, ranked among the top 5 Rust projects on GitHub, is open-source remote desktop software developed in Rust and Flutter.
points: Fixed over 30 bugs, enhancing software stability and user experience.
Implemented multiple features, prioritizing improvements for Wayland Linux and Windows support and UI enhancements.
Continued involvement post-internship by collaborating on a funded feature for Auto Display Switch upon cursor/window switch during remote sessions.
